reference_meta.source: eloialonso/iris:results/data/RANDOM.json and HUMAN.json; identical to the Random/Human columns of IRIS Table 1, TWM Table 1, DIAMOND Table 1, SPR Table 4, CURL Table 2, DrQ Table 5, EfficientZero Table 1, BBF Table A.1, SR-SPR Table 4, EZ-V2 Table 1.
reference_meta.notes: Standard Atari random/human references used by all methods here. DreamerV3, STORM and Delta-IRIS print them rounded to integers (STORM prints KungFuMaster random as 256 instead of 258.5). SimPLe Table 3 prints different random/human values of its own.

meta.hns_formula: (score - random) / (human - random), per game, using reference above; mean/median over the 26 games of the per-game mean scores
meta.scores_semantics: per-game mean over runs/seeds as printed in the primary source named in "source"
meta.null_means: value not published in the primary source

SimPLe.paper: Kaiser et al., "Model-Based Reinforcement Learning for Atari", ICLR 2020 (arXiv 1903.00374, final revision)
SimPLe.source: SimPLe paper (final arXiv revision) Table 3, "SimPLe" column (mean over 5 runs; = "Ours, SD long" variant of Table 2). Identical (to 0.1) to the per-seed file eloialonso/iris:results/data/SimPLe.json (5 runs/game; rliable data) and to the SimPLe column of IRIS Table 1 / TWM Table 1 / STORM Table 2 / DIAMOND Table 1.
SimPLe.notes: This is the canonical SimPLe row used by IRIS/TWM/STORM/DIAMOND. SimPLe Table 3 prints its own random/human columns (e.g. Alien random 184.8 vs the standard 227.8; Frostbite human missing); HNS here always uses the standard references. Earlier arXiv revisions reported a different default variant ("SD", e.g. Alien 405.2 - see van Hasselt et al. 2019 Table 1). Do not confuse with SimPLe_max_of_variants below.
SimPLe.reported_aggregate_source: IRIS Table 1 and TWM Table 1 (the SimPLe paper itself prints no human-normalized aggregate).

SimPLe_max_of_variants.paper: SimPLe numbers as tabulated by CURL (Table 2), DrQ (Table 5), SPR (Table 4), EfficientZero (Table 1), EfficientZero V2 (Table 1)
SimPLe_max_of_variants.source: SPR paper Table 4 "SimPLe" column (identical in CURL Table 2, DrQ Table 5, EfficientZero Table 1, EZ-V2 Table 1).
SimPLe_max_of_variants.notes: Verified for all 26 games: each value equals max(SimPLe "SD" variant as printed in van Hasselt et al. 2019 Table 1, SimPLe final "SD long" Table 3). I.e. a per-game best-of-two-variants row, which is optimistic. Included only so that tables copied from CURL/DrQ/SPR/EfficientZero can be reproduced; prefer "SimPLe" for comparisons.
SimPLe_max_of_variants.reported_aggregate_source: SPR Table 4; CURL paper Sec. 6.2 text (44.3% / 14.4%); EfficientZero Table 1.

DER.paper: van Hasselt, Hessel & Aslanides, "When to use parametric models in reinforcement learning?", NeurIPS 2019
DER.source: van Hasselt et al. 2019 Table 1, "Rainbow" column (the data-efficient Rainbow; mean at end of training over 5 seeds). Identical to "Eff. Rainbow" in CURL Table 2 / DrQ Table 5 and "DER" in SPR Table 4.
DER.notes: Original published DER numbers. Number of evaluation episodes not stated in the paper. Later papers (TWM, BBF) instead use the DER re-run of Agarwal et al. 2021 - see DER_rliable.
DER.reported_aggregate_source: SPR Table 4 and CURL Sec. 6.2 (28.5% / 16.1%); DrQ Table 5 median 0.161. The DER paper itself only plots the median curve (Fig. 3), no printed aggregate.

DER_rliable.paper: DER re-implementation in Dopamine by Agarwal et al., "Deep RL at the Edge of the Statistical Precipice", NeurIPS 2021 (100 runs)
DER_rliable.source: TWM Table 1 "DER" column; identical in BBF Table A.1. Underlying per-run data is in gs://rl-benchmark-data/atari_100k/DER.json (not reachable from this environment).
DER_rliable.notes: Secondary source: Agarwal et al. 2021 print no per-game table (figures only), so per-game values are taken from two independent downstream tables (TWM, BBF) that agree exactly. Not the same numbers as the original DER paper.

CURL.paper: Srinivas, Laskin & Abbeel, "CURL: Contrastive Unsupervised Representations for Reinforcement Learning", ICML 2020
CURL.source: CURL paper (ICML camera-ready, arXiv v3+) Table 2, "CURL" column (20 seeds). Identical in SPR Table 4, EfficientZero Table 1, EZ-V2 Table 1.
CURL.notes: Earlier CURL preprint numbers (3 seeds; e.g. Alien 1148.2, quoted in DrQ Table 5 as "OT/Eff. Rainbow+CURL") differ - not used. IRIS/TWM use a different CURL row (rliable re-evaluation) - see CURL_rliable.
CURL.reported_aggregate_source: CURL paper Sec. 6.2 text (mean 38.1%, median 17.5%); SPR Table 4.

CURL_rliable.paper: CURL re-evaluated by Agarwal et al. 2021 (100 runs, authors' code)
CURL_rliable.source: IRIS Table 1 "CURL" column (identical in TWM Table 1). Reproduced to 0.1 from eloialonso/iris:results/data/CURL_10_evals.json (100 runs/game, stored as HNS; converted back to raw with the standard references).
CURL_rliable.notes: This is the CURL row that IRIS, TWM, DreamerV3 v1 (Table S.1) compare against; it is much weaker than CURL's own paper numbers.

DrQ.paper: Kostrikov, Yarats & Fergus, "Image Augmentation Is All You Need: Regularizing Deep RL from Pixels", ICLR 2021
DrQ.source: DrQ paper Table 5, "Eff. DQN + DrQ (Ours)" column (5 seeds). Identical in SPR Table 4, EfficientZero Table 1, EZ-V2 Table 1.
DrQ.notes: Evaluation per DrQ Appendix C: 125k env steps of evaluation at the end of 100k steps; non-standard epsilon settings (see DrQ(eps)).
DrQ.reported_aggregate_source: DrQ Table 5 (median only). Mean 0.357 is reported by SPR Table 4 / EfficientZero Table 1, not by the DrQ paper.

DrQ(eps).paper: DrQ with standard epsilon-greedy settings, Agarwal et al., "Deep RL at the Edge of the Statistical Precipice", NeurIPS 2021
DrQ(eps).source: eloialonso/iris:results/data/DrQ(eps).json (100 runs/game, from the rliable data release); per-game means = IRIS Table 1 "DrQ" column = TWM Table 1 "DrQ(eps)" = BBF Table A.1 "DrQ(eps)".
DrQ(eps).notes: DrQ(eps): training eps decayed to 0.01 (not 0.1), evaluation eps 0.001 (not 0.05) (Agarwal et al. App. A.2). IRIS Table 1 labels this column "DrQ" - it is DrQ(eps), not the DrQ paper numbers.
DrQ(eps).reported_aggregate_source: IRIS Table 1 (labelled "DrQ"), TWM Table 1, BBF Table A.1 (IQM 0.280). The rliable paper prints no per-game or aggregate numbers.

SPR.paper: Schwarzer et al., "Data-Efficient Reinforcement Learning with Self-Predictive Representations", ICLR 2021
SPR.source: SPR paper Table 4 (Appendix A.1), "SPR" column (10 seeds; mean episodic return at end of training). Identical in EfficientZero Table 1 and EZ-V2 Table 1.
SPR.notes: IRIS/TWM/BBF/DreamerV3 compare against the rliable 100-run re-evaluation instead (SPR_rliable: mean 0.616 / median 0.396).

SPR_rliable.paper: SPR re-evaluated by Agarwal et al. 2021 (100 runs, authors' code)
SPR_rliable.source: eloialonso/iris:results/data/SPR.json (100 runs/game); means = IRIS Table 1 "SPR" = TWM Table 1 = BBF Table A.1 "SPR".
SPR_rliable.notes: Same method as SPR; different run set/evaluation.
SPR_rliable.reported_aggregate_source: IRIS Table 1 (IQM 0.337); TWM Table 1; BBF Table A.1.

SR-SPR.paper: D'Oro et al., "Sample-Efficient Reinforcement Learning by Breaking the Replay Ratio Barrier", ICLR 2023
SR-SPR.source: SR-SPR paper (OpenReview PDF) Table 4 (Appendix D.1), "SR-SPR:16" column (replay ratio 16 = headline SR-SPR).
SR-SPR.notes: Seeds: SR-SPR Fig. 3 caption says 20 seeds; BBF Table A.1 caption says 30 seeds for SR-SPR. BBF Table A.1 reproduces this column except Krull (5911.8 there vs 5914.4 here). UpNDown (112450.3, ~10.9 HNS) dominates the mean. Replay ratio 16 = 16 gradient updates per env step with periodic resets: much higher compute than SPR.

BBF.paper: Schwarzer et al., "Bigger, Better, Faster: Human-level Atari with human-level efficiency", ICML 2023
BBF.source: BBF paper Table A.1, "BBF" column (50 seeds per game per caption). Identical in EZ-V2 Table 1 "BBF" column.
BBF.notes: Model-free (no lookahead search), but very large compute: ResNet-15x4 network, replay ratio 8, shrink-and-perturb resets, n-step/gamma annealing. Repo google-research/bigger_better_faster/scores/RR8_BBF.csv has 52-60 seeds/game and gives slightly different per-game means (mean HNS 2.238, median 0.880) - the paper table is used here.

EfficientZero.paper: Ye et al., "Mastering Atari Games with Limited Data", NeurIPS 2021
EfficientZero.source: EfficientZero arXiv v2 (12 Dec 2021) Table 1, "Ours" column (3 runs x 32 evaluation episodes). Identical to eloialonso/iris:results/data/EfficientZero.json and EZ-V2 Table 1.
EfficientZero.notes: MCTS lookahead (MuZero-style) with a learned model; much more planning compute per step than world-model/model-free agents. arXiv v1 numbers were superseded by v2 (NeurIPS camera-ready). BBF Table A.1 prints Qbert 14448.5 (source unknown; not in either EfficientZero version I checked) - hence BBF's 1.945/1.116.

other_reported_aggregates.source: EfficientZero arXiv v1 (30 Oct 2021) Table 1 - different per-game numbers (e.g. Alien 1140.3, Qbert 15458.1)
EZ-V2 Table 1 (same per-game numbers as v2)

EfficientZero V2.paper: Wang et al., "EfficientZero V2: Mastering Discrete and Continuous Control with Limited Data", ICML 2024
EfficientZero V2.source: EZ-V2 arXiv v2 (12 Sep 2024) Table 1, "EZ-V2 (Ours)" column; same values in arXiv v1 Table 1.
EfficientZero V2.notes: MISMATCH: the printed per-game numbers give mean 2.680 / median 1.235 under the standard HNS, not 2.428 / 1.286. Re-extracted twice (v1 and v2 PDFs); Asterix is printed as 61810.0 (7.43 HNS) and Appendix Table 6 repeats it. The paper does not define its normalization. Number of seeds for Atari 100k not stated in the paper (3 seeds stated only for DMC). Gumbel search with 16 simulations (Atari 100k). Treat aggregates with caution.
EfficientZero V2.reported_aggregate_source: EZ-V2 Table 1 and text ("mean score of 2.428 and a median score of 1.286").

IRIS.paper: Micheli, Alonso & Fleuret, "Transformers are Sample-Efficient World Models", ICLR 2023
IRIS.source: IRIS paper (arXiv v2) Table 1, "IRIS" column. Equal (to 0.1) to the means of eloialonso/iris:results/data/IRIS.json (5 seeds/game).
IRIS.notes: Average over 100 episodes collected at the end of training, 5 runs. IRIS lowers the Boltzmann exploration temperature on Freeway (per-game tweak noted by STORM Sec. 5.3). The results notebook output in the repo still prints "3 runs" (stale); the json has 5.

Delta-IRIS.paper: Micheli, Alonso & Fleuret, "Efficient World Models with Context-Aware Tokenization", ICML 2024
Delta-IRIS.source: Delta-IRIS arXiv v1 (27 Jun 2024) Table 8 (Appendix C), "Delta-IRIS (ours)" column (integers; 5 seeds, 100 eval episodes).
Delta-IRIS.notes: The repo file vmicheli/delta-iris:results/atari.json (added Sep 2024) does NOT match the paper (e.g. Alien 599.2 vs 391, Qbert 3438.2 vs 1444); the README says the released Atari config scores "slightly higher aggregate metrics than those reported in the paper" and links an updated table. Repo-file aggregate: mean 1.383, median 0.594. The paper numbers are used for "scores".
Delta-IRIS.reported_aggregate_source: Delta-IRIS Table 8 (mean 1.39, IQM 0.65; no median reported).

TWM.paper: Robine et al., "Transformer-based World Models Are Happy With 100k Interactions", ICLR 2023
TWM.source: TWM paper Table 1, "TWM (ours)" column. Equal (to 0.1) to the means of jrobine/twm:results/scores.json (5 runs/game).
TWM.notes: 5 runs per game; average over 100 episodes at the end of training for each run.

STORM.paper: Zhang et al., "STORM: Efficient Stochastic Transformer based World Models for Reinforcement Learning", NeurIPS 2023
STORM.source: STORM paper Table 2, "STORM (ours)" column (printed as integers). The per-seed file weipu-zhang/STORM:results/storm.json (5 seeds) reproduces every game to the printed precision except Freeway (file = 0.0 for all seeds = "Freeway w/o traj").
STORM.notes: Freeway = 34 was obtained by adding one pre-collected demonstration trajectory (from a pre-trained DQN) to the replay buffer (Sec. 5.3). Without it Freeway = 0 and the paper reports mean 122.3% (computed here from Table 2 with Freeway 0: 1.223 / median 0.426; from storm.json: 1.222 / 0.425). For a demonstration-free comparison use Freeway = 0. 5 seeds; 20 evaluation episodes per checkpoint, final checkpoints averaged. Integer rounding in the table makes the computed median 0.582 vs 0.584 printed. DIAMOND Table 1 prints STORM Freeway as 33.5 (source not stated) and otherwise the storm.json values.

DreamerV3.paper: Hafner et al., "Mastering Diverse Domains through World Models", arXiv:2301.04104v1 (10 Jan 2023)
DreamerV3.source: DreamerV3 arXiv v1 Table S.1 ("Atari 100K Scores"), DreamerV3 column. The table has only 25 game rows: Up N Down is missing.
DreamerV3.notes: Version used: arXiv v1, the version cited by IRIS-era/STORM/DIAMOND tables. "Performance of the stochastic training policy" (training-episode returns, no separate evaluation runs). Seed count for Atari 100k not stated in v1; the authors' v1-era score file (danijar/dreamerv3 commit 423291a, scores/data/atari100k_dreamerv3.json.gz) has 5 seeds/game, but its curves do not reproduce Table S.1 exactly. UpNDown is null because v1 does not print it; the printed 112%/49% are reproduced only if UpNDown is in [7564, 7786] (STORM's 7667 qualifies; DIAMOND's 9234 gives 1.130/0.560). DIAMOND prints DreamerV3 mean 1.097 and Delta-IRIS 1.10, which do not follow from their own per-game columns (1.130). The 2024 revision (v2) has substantially different per-game numbers - see DreamerV3_v2_2024.
DreamerV3.reported_aggregate_source: DreamerV3 v1 Table S.1 ("Human Mean 112%", "Human Median 49%").

UpNDown.source: STORM Table 2 (DreamerV3 column); provenance not stated
DIAMOND Table 1 and Delta-IRIS Table 8; equals the mean over 5 seeds of the 400k-step bin in danijar/dreamerv3 commit 423291a scores/data/atari100k_dreamerv3.json.gz

DreamerV3 (2024).paper: Hafner et al., "Mastering Diverse Domains through World Models", arXiv:2301.04104v2 (17 Apr 2024); published as "Mastering diverse control tasks through world models", Nature 2025
DreamerV3 (2024).source: DreamerV3 arXiv v2 Table 9 ("Atari100k scores at 400K environment steps"), "Dreamer" column. All 26 values reproduced exactly from danijar/dreamerv3:scores/atari100k-dreamerv3.json.gz (2024 commit 2411f7d) as: per seed, mean of training-episode returns ending at env step >= 390k; then mean over seeds that have such an episode.
DreamerV3 (2024).notes: Differs strongly from v1 (e.g. UpNDown 46910, Frostbite 3377, PrivateEye 3238, Pong -4, Breakout 10). In the score file, UpNDown (46910) comes from a single seed (only 1/5 seeds has an episode ending after 390k), and CrazyClimber/Gopher/KungFuMaster/Pong from 4/5 seeds. The Nature 2025 article could not be accessed from this environment, so it is unverified whether its Atari100k table equals v2.

DIAMOND.paper: Alonso et al., "Diffusion for World Modeling: Visual Details Matter in Atari", NeurIPS 2024
DIAMOND.source: DIAMOND arXiv v2 (30 Oct 2024) Table 1, "DIAMOND (ours)" column. Equal (to 0.1) to the means of eloialonso/diamond:results/data/DIAMOND.json (5 seeds/game).
DIAMOND.notes: 5 seeds. DIAMOND Table 1 baseline columns: DreamerV3 = v1 Table S.1 plus UpNDown 9234 (see DreamerV3 notes); STORM = storm.json means with Freeway 33.5.
DIAMOND.reported_aggregate_source: DIAMOND Table 1 (mean 1.459, IQM 0.641, #superhuman 11). No median is reported anywhere in the paper.
